title: The Loose Ghost
author: August Montrose
blurb: Sebastian Halloran, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
